'''Gifu Shichifukujin''' (ぎふ七福神, "Gifu Seven Lucky Gods") is a pilgrimage route of '''Seven Lucky Gods''' (*Shichifukujin*) located in the northeastern part of [[:en:Gifu City|Gifu City]], extending into the northwestern part of [[Kakamigahara City]], {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|en|Gifu Prefecture|qid=Q131277|lt=Gifu Prefecture}}. The route consists of '''Sōtō Zen Buddhist temples''' and was '''established in 2012'''.

== List of Gifu Shichifukujin Temples ==
The pilgrimage course consists of six temples, as '''Fukurokuju''' and '''Jurōjin''' are enshrined together at the same temple.

* '''{{ill|Daikokuten|en|Daikokuten|qid=Q1759916|lt=Daikokuten}}''': {{ill|Zuigan-ji Temple (Kakamigahara)|ja|瑞巌寺 (各務原市)|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 瑞巖寺 (各務原市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q110555161}} – '''Kita-hora, Kakamigahara City'''
* '''{{ill|Ebisu|ja|恵比寿|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to えびす (曖昧さ回避)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q255907}}''': {{ill|Chishō-in Temple|ja|智照院 (岐阜市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q106836887}} – '''Iwata Nishi, Gifu City'''
* '''{{ill|Budai|en|Budai|qid=Q599838|lt=Hotei}}''': {{ill|Rin'yō-ji Temple|ja|林陽寺|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q106577615}} – '''Iwata Nishi, Gifu City'''
* '''{{ill|Vaiśravaṇa|en|Vaiśravaṇa|qid=Q866315|lt=Bishamonten}}''': {{ill|Ryūun-ji Temple (Gifu)|ja|龍雲寺 (岐阜市)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q106836885}} – '''Akutami Ōfunamachi, Gifu City'''
* '''{{ill|Benzaiten|ja|弁財天}}''': {{ill|Kisshō-ji (Gifu)|ja|吉祥寺 (岐阜市)|qid=Q140446013}} – '''Tarōmaru, Gifu City'''
* '''{{ill|Jurōjin|en|Jurōjin|qid=Q389611|lt=Jurōjin}} & {{ill|Fukurokuju|en|Fukurokuju|qid=Q780797|lt=Fukurokuju}}''': {{ill|Daikaku-ji (Gifu)|ja|大覚寺 (岐阜市)|qid=Q140446014}} – '''Nagara, Gifu City'''
